tier1.text: Each anconeus extends the forearm, which straightens the elbow. The anconeus shares this job with the triceps brachii, a muscle at the back of the upper arm. The anconeus is a small muscle at the back of the elbow, toward the outer side.

quotes.quote: The forearm, made of the radius and ulna bones, has four main types of action at the hinge of the elbow joint: flexion, extension, pronation, and supination. The forearm flexors include the biceps brachii, brachialis, and brachioradialis. The extensors are the triceps brachii and anconeus.
